messages:
Maya I.: Heads-up — we plan a midnight backfill for demo/tier-B pool this Thu 02:00 UTC to reclaim a few drained slots. Need a quick capacity sanity check and vendor handoff plan.
Omar K.: +1 Which regions are we targeting?
Maya I.: eu-west1 primary, us-west2 fallback. Target is to add ~8 A100-equivalent slots for 6 hours.
Liam T.: Do we have quota headroom in eu-west1? I last saw soft-quota at 6/8 used but that was yesterday.
Maya I.: I opened a quota check with cloud yesterday but haven't heard back. Tagging @Rebecca V. for vendor ETA if we need baremetal burst.
Rebecca V.: On it — vendor says they can stand up 4 racks in eu-west within 8 hours, but need confirmed PO and tenant CID list. If we only need 8 GPUs, we can do a partial carve from our partner pool quicker (2–3 hours).
Maya I.: Ok good. Two quick asks: 1) can infra confirm terraform plan for tenant lock so we don't accidentally reassign slots during backfill? 2) who wants to own vendor handshake if we need racks?
Omar K.: I can own TF plan. I'll open a PR and tag for review. Will also add a small canary: route 10% of demo traffic to the new pool during the window.
Liam T.: FYI add the KV-cache warmup step in the smoke script — otherwise cold token latency spikes during demos.
Maya I.: thanks. PR link when ready?
Omar K.: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/compare/358-backfill-tenant-lock — includes lock labels + canary config. Please review asap.
Rebecca V.: Vendor asks for tenant CID list and an outage-free window. If you need racks in <3 hours, we can do partial carve now but billing will attach to temporary account until PO finishes.
Maya I.: Understood. For billing: finance ok with temp charge?
Omar K.: I already pinged finance — they said emergency carve ok under existing vendor contract, send email after the work.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: maintenance window for demo/tier-B backfill Thu 02:00 UTC — duration 6h — owner: Omar K.
Liam T.: Quick checklist before Thu: 1) TF PR merged 2) tenant CID list posted to the vendor doc 3) smoke + KV-warmup rehearsed in staging 4) oncall aware.
Maya I.: I'll collate checklist and post to the incident-style doc. Anyone can add items.
Rebecca V.: If we go with the partial carve, I'll handle vendor provisioning and handoff to Omar once racks are ready.
Omar K.: I'll try to get the PR merged by EOD so we can rehearse in staging tonight. If finance needs PO earlier I'll escalate.
Maya I.: Perfect. If anything blocks, drop it here and @oncall for escalation. :thumbsup:
